fusions.name: Scattered Mouths
fusions.desc: Looses 5 darting insects in a wide spread, each dealing 3 nature damage. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gnawed Hide
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 12 nature damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Cloud Over the Field
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud for 10 seconds that bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each kill you make while it is out restores 3 health, and your movement speed rises by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Bellies
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
